case_title: AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING VS ROCA DEL MAR MEXICAN RESTAURANT

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $820.86 FILED BY AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING CENTER AS TO DEFENDANT ROCA DEL MAR MEXICAN RESTAURANT ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-23-1994 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 02
